name: goaop/shop-demo
description: Reference shop application for Go! AOP 4: aspects in action, plus a reproducible benchmark of debug, production and prebuilt-cache modes

scripts-descriptions.warmup: Build the AOP cache of the mode given by APP_MODE (default prod)
scripts-descriptions.serve: Start the built-in web server on http://127.0.0.1:8080/?mode=prod
scripts-descriptions.bench: Run every benchmark (~15 minutes), results in results/
